edges.reason: msg.sender is used for blacklist checks and fee exemption decisions in the transfer path
enableDisableDevFee authorizes with msg.sender == liquidityWallet instead of the onlyOwner modifier
processDividendTracker emits tx.origin as the processor, creating origin dependency
_transfer emits tx.origin in ProcessedDividendTracker
swapTokensForDividendToken passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline
canAutoClaim compares block.timestamp against the last claim time
getAccount derives nextClaimTime and secondsUntilAutoClaimAvailable from block.timestamp
_withdrawDividendOfUser performs an external ERC20 transfer to the user-controlled payout flow
withdrawnDividends is written before the external token transfer, and a malicious dividendToken can reenter the payout path
_withdrawDividendOfUser reads the mutable dividendToken address to build the transfer target
swapAndSendToDev forwards swapped ETH to the dev address via transfer
enableDisableDevFee writes the _swapEnabled dev fee toggle
activate flips tradingEnabled to true
activate enables automatic swaps
updateGasForProcessing writes the gas forwarded to dividend processing
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping used for sell limits
addBotToBlackList writes the blacklist mapping checked in transfers
excludeFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping
_transfer computes fees from the amount with mul and div
fee arithmetic result is stored in the fees local variable
swapTokensForDividendToken invokes the router swap external call
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap external call
swapAndSendDividends transfers the reward token balance it holds
after the reward token transfer the tracker distributeDividends is invoked, transferring control
distributeDividends computes the magnified share increment from the amount and totalSupply
the computed magnified amount updates magnifiedDividendPerShare
_transfer calls dividendTracker.setBalance inside a try/catch, transferring control outside the contract
_transfer calls dividendTracker.process inside a try/catch, transferring control outside the contract
the liquidating flag guards the liquify block within the transfer
the process loop consults canAutoClaim for each holder
the process loop calls processAccount which withdraws dividends externally
processAccount delegates the payout to _withdrawDividendOfUser
_withdrawDividendOfUser derives the withdrawable amount from accumulativeDividendOf
setBalance adjusts the holder balance through _setBalance mint/burn
setBalance triggers processAccount to auto claim for the account
setDividendTokenAddress has no access control and lets anyone repoint the reward token
processDividendTracker invokes the tracker process loop externally
excludeFromDividends zeroes the balance through _setBalance
claim processes the dividend account of msg.sender
claim delegates to dividendTracker.processAccount

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only participates in the transfer logic and is folded into the eVAULT._transfer function node
The to parameter only participates in the transfer logic and is folded into the eVAULT._transfer function node
The amount parameter feeds the fee arithmetic and max transaction checks in eVAULT._transfer
The account parameter is used only for inserting into the blacklist structure inside addBotToBlackList
The newValue parameter is assigned directly to gasForProcessing inside updateGasForProcessing
The gas parameter is forwarded to the tracker process call inside processDividendTracker
The user parameter is the payout recipient in the dividend withdrawal routine
The account parameter is the paid account in processAccount
The gas parameter bounds the loop inside process
The fees local is the direct result of the fee arithmetic operation
The contract token balance local is only used for the liquify decision inside _transfer
The swapTokens local drives the dev swap branch inside _transfer
The sellTokens local is the argument passed to the dividend swap routine
The takeFee local gates the fee branch inside _transfer
The cached trading flag is only consumed by the transfer logic

The withdrawable dividend local drives the external token transfer in _withdrawDividendOfUser
The dividends local is the amount transferred to the dividend tracker by the reward token transfer
